final_note: By the end of Chapter 7, Kestrel is no longer simply accompanying the anomaly—she is part of the line that keeps things from breaking, choosing presence, restraint, and deliberate trust in a world that rewards neither.
final_note_addendum_ch9: By the end of Chapter 9, Kestrel is no longer just the line that keeps things from breaking—she is part of a live, visible cohort inside an institution designed to sort, watch, and exploit. She adapts without surrendering values: consent, autonomy, quiet competence, and civilian-shielding priorities. The suite becomes a new proving ground—one measured in recovery, boundaries, and how power behaves when no one is cheering.
